# MyDocPro

> Compress, resize and convert images, merge and split PDFs, and prepare application photos for free. Files stay on your device while you use the tools.

## Tools and site information

- [Free Online Photo Editor, No Sign-up](https://mydocpro.co.in/image-editor): Crop, rotate and resize photos for free. Adjust brightness and contrast in your browser and download without a watermark.
- [Free PDF Tools Online – Merge, Split, Compress](https://mydocpro.co.in/pdf-toolkit): Merge, split, compress or organize PDFs for free in your browser. Turn photos into PDFs or export pages as images, with no upload or sign-up.
- [Free Image Compressor – 20 KB, 50 KB or 100 KB](https://mydocpro.co.in/compress-image): Compress photos free to 20 KB, 50 KB, 100 KB or a custom target. Use JPG, PNG or WebP images and download the result as a JPG.
- [Resize Image in CM, MM & Pixels Free](https://mydocpro.co.in/resize-image): Resize photos in cm, mm or pixels and set a KB limit. Choose DPI, preview your image and download free. No sign-up; files stay on your device.
- [Convert JPG, PNG and WebP Images Online Free](https://mydocpro.co.in/convert-image): Convert JPG to PNG, PNG to JPG, or images to and from WebP for free. Choose your output format and download without uploading your image.
- [Crop Images Online Free – Custom Aspect Ratios](https://mydocpro.co.in/crop-image): Crop images free with a custom, square, 4:3, 16:9 or 35:45 frame. Rotate your photo, check the framing and download in your browser.
- [Merge PDF Files Online Free – Combine PDFs](https://mydocpro.co.in/merge-pdf): Merge PDFs and images free into one file. Arrange pages in the order you need and download the merged document. Your files stay on your device.
- [Split PDF Online Free – Extract PDF Pages](https://mydocpro.co.in/split-pdf): Split PDFs free by selecting pages or page ranges. Download one document or save each page as a separate PDF without uploading your file.
- [Compress PDF to 100 KB, 200 KB or 500 KB Free](https://mydocpro.co.in/compress-pdf): Compress PDFs free with a size target or custom quality. Supported embedded images are recompressed while preserving text. Processing stays in your browser.
- [JPG to PDF Converter Online Free](https://mydocpro.co.in/jpg-to-pdf): Convert JPG, PNG or WebP images to PDF free. Arrange photos, choose A4, Letter or image-sized pages, and download without an upload.
- [Free Exam Photo Resizer for Application Forms](https://mydocpro.co.in/exam-photo): Resize application photos to standard sizes for free. Choose DPI and maximum KB, then check your form’s requirements before downloading.
- [Free Signature Cleaner for Online Forms](https://mydocpro.co.in/signature): Clean a scanned signature free on white paper. Adjust the threshold to keep faint pen strokes, preview and download as JPG, PNG or WebP.
- [Free Passport Photo Maker – 4 × 6 Inch or A4 Sheet](https://mydocpro.co.in/passport-sheet): Make a printable passport photo sheet on 4 × 6 inch or A4 paper. Choose photo size, DPI, copy count and optional cut guides, free in your browser.
- [PDF to JPG Converter Online Free](https://mydocpro.co.in/pdf-to-image): Convert PDF pages to JPG, PNG or WebP free. Choose pages and resolution, then download one image per page in your browser.
- [Organize PDF Free – Reorder, Rotate, Delete](https://mydocpro.co.in/organize-pdf): Rearrange, rotate or remove pages from a PDF online for free. Check the new page order in the preview and download the document without an upload.
- [Add Name and Date on Photo Free for Exam Forms](https://mydocpro.co.in/name-date): Add a name and date below your photo free for application forms. Preview the text strip and download the finished photo without an upload.
- [Join Images Online Free – JPG or A4 PDF](https://mydocpro.co.in/join-images): Join 2–6 images in a row, column or grid. Combine Aadhaar front and back on one page, adjust spacing and download a JPG or A4 PDF locally.
- [Whiten a Light Photo Background Online Free](https://mydocpro.co.in/white-background): Whiten a plain photo background free using edge-connected colour matching. Adjust tolerance and preview the result before downloading.
- [About MyDocPro – Free, Private Document Tools](https://mydocpro.co.in/about): Learn how MyDocPro’s free image and PDF tools process your files in your browser and what to check before submitting a document.
- [Privacy Policy](https://mydocpro.co.in/privacy): Learn which files MyDocPro processes on your device and how it handles browser storage, advertising, analytics and messages sent through the contact form.
- [Contact Us](https://mydocpro.co.in/contact): Questions, feedback or a tool request? Get in touch with the MyDocPro team.
- [Help & FAQ – How to Use MyDocPro Tools](https://mydocpro.co.in/help): Find help with image dimensions and file size limits, PDF processing, downloads and using MyDocPro offline.
- [What’s New](https://mydocpro.co.in/updates): The latest tools, features and improvements added to MyDocPro.
- [NEET UG Photo, Signature & Thumb Resizer](https://mydocpro.co.in/exam-photo/neet-ug): Prepare JPGs of your passport photo, signature and hand impressions for NEET UG 2026. Check the file sizes privately before uploading them to NTA.
- [JEE Main Photo & Signature Resizer](https://mydocpro.co.in/exam-photo/jee-main): Resize photo (10–200KB) and signature (10–100KB) for JEE Main 2027 in JPG format. Free, no sign-up, no upload.
- [UPSC Photo & Signature Resizer](https://mydocpro.co.in/exam-photo/upsc): Resize your UPSC photo (20–200KB) and triple signature (20–100KB) in JPG. Free, private, works on mobile. Files never leave your device.
- [SSC Signature Resizer (CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD)](https://mydocpro.co.in/exam-photo/ssc): Prepare a 10–20 KB JPG signature for SSC forms. Check your scan, read live photo tips and resize privately in your browser.
- [IBPS Photo, Signature, Thumb & Declaration Resizer](https://mydocpro.co.in/exam-photo/ibps): Resize your IBPS photo, signature, thumb impression or handwritten declaration. Use the scanned image presets and check your recruitment’s instructions.
- [RRB NTPC Signature Resizer](https://mydocpro.co.in/exam-photo/rrb-ntpc): Resize your signature for RRB NTPC 2026: 30–49KB JPG, min 140×60 px. Photo is captured live. Free, no upload.
